```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

This script prepares Apicomplexa ASVs for phylogenetic placement. It subsets the
full phyloseq object to Apicomplexa taxa from healthy coral samples, writes the ASV
names to `../data/apicomplexan_asvs_healthy_present.txt` for downstream use, and
exports an ASV–metadata table to
`../../microbiome/data/ASV_table_apicomplexa_healthy_present.xlsx`.

The bash chunks (`eval=FALSE`) document the HPC pipeline run on a compute cluster:
backbone SSU rRNA tree inference with RAxML, followed by evolutionary placement of
amplicon ASVs onto the backbone using HMMER alignment and RAxML EPA.

See `apicomplexan_tree_itol.Rmd` for the iTOL annotation step.

```{r load-data}
ps_plas_V3_V4 <- readRDS("../../microbiome/data/ps_final.rds")
```

# Extract Apicomplexa ASVs

We extracted 421 sequences from the dataset.

```{r extract-apicomplexa}
library(phyloseq)
library(magrittr)

# 1. Subset to Apicomplexan only
ps_apis <- subset_taxa(ps_plas_V3_V4, Subdivision == "Apicomplexa")

# 2. Subset to healthy samples
ps_apis_healthy <- subset_samples(ps_apis, coral_health == "healthy")

# 3. Keep only ASVs present (non-zero) in healthy samples
ps_apis_healthy_present <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(ps_apis_healthy) > 0,
  ps_apis_healthy
)

# 4. Extract ASV names and write to file
apicomplexan_asvs_healthy_present <- taxa_names(ps_apis_healthy_present)

dir.create("../data", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write(apicomplexan_asvs_healthy_present,
      file = "../data/apicomplexan_asvs_healthy_present.txt")  # phylogenies/data/
```

```{r sanity-checks}
length(taxa_names(ps_apis))                    # ASVs before filtering
length(apicomplexan_asvs_healthy_present)      # ASVs after healthy + presence filtering
all(taxa_sums(ps_apis_healthy_present) > 0)    # confirm no zero-abundance taxa remain
```

# With metadata

```{r export-metadata}
library(phyloseq)
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)

# 1. Convert OTU table to a data frame (samples as rows)
otu_df <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_apis_healthy_present))
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_apis_healthy_present)) otu_df <- t(otu_df)
otu_df <- as.data.frame(otu_df)
otu_df$SampleID <- rownames(otu_df)

# 2. Pivot long and join sample metadata
sample_df <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps_apis_healthy_present))
sample_df$SampleID <- rownames(sample_df)

otu_long <- otu_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -SampleID, names_to = "ASV", values_to = "Abundance") %>%
  left_join(sample_df, by = "SampleID")

# 3. Join taxonomy
tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_apis_healthy_present))
tax_df$ASV <- rownames(tax_df)

final_df <- otu_long %>%
  left_join(tax_df, by = "ASV") %>%
  filter(Abundance > 0)

# 4. Write to Excel
write.xlsx(final_df, "../../microbiome/data/ASV_table_apicomplexa_healthy_present.xlsx")
```

# SSU tree — build backbone

The following bash chunks document the HPC pipeline steps.
They are not executed on knit (`eval=FALSE`); adjust paths and
thread counts for your environment.

```{bash build-backbone, eval=FALSE}
# Build backbone tree with RAxML
# Requires: raxml environment with raxmlHPC-PTHREADS

raxmlHPC-PTHREADS \
  -T 16 \
  -m GTRGAMMAIX \
  -p 31415 \
  -x 20398 \
  -d \
  -f a \
  -N 1000 \
  -n api_plastid_ssu.tre \
  -s api_plastid_ssu.trimal.fa
```

# Extract Apicomplexan sequences from full ASV FASTA

```{bash extract-seqs, eval=FALSE}
cd ../data/EPA

awk '
FNR==NR { arr[$0]; next }
/^>/ {
  found = ""
  match($0, /^>[^.]*/)
  if (substr($0, RSTART+1, RLENGTH-1) in arr) found = 1
}
found
' apicomplexan_asvs_healthy_present.txt ASVs.fa > ASVs_extracted.fa

# Linearise (one sequence per line)
awk '/^>/ { printf("\n%s\n", $0); next } { printf("%s", $0) } END { printf("\n") }' \
  ASVs_extracted.fa > ASVs_extracted_oneline.fa
```

# EPA placement

## Align short reads to backbone HMM

```{bash epa-align, eval=FALSE}
# Requires: hmmer and trees conda environments

conda activate trees

perl fasta2stockholm.pl api_plastid_ssu.aligned.fa > api_plastid_ssu.aligned.sto
hmmbuild api_plastid_ssu.hmm api_plastid_ssu.aligned.sto
hmmalign --dna --mapali api_plastid_ssu.aligned.fa api_plastid_ssu.hmm \
  ASVs_extracted_oneline.fa > epa.aligned.sto

# Convert to FASTA and clean up gap characters
perl stockholm2fasta.pl epa.aligned.sto > epa.aligned.fa
awk '/^>/ { print; next } { gsub("\\.", "-"); print }' epa.aligned.fa > cleaned_epa.aligned.fa
```

## RAxML EPA placement

```{bash epa-placement, eval=FALSE}
raxmlHPC -T 4 -m GTRGAMMAX -f v -G 0.2 \
  -n EPARUN.tre \
  -s cleaned_epa.aligned.fa \
  -t RAxML_bipartitions.api_plastid_ssu.tre

sed 's/QUERY___//g' RAxML_labelledTree.EPARUN.tre | sed 's/\[I[0-9]*\]//g' \
  > RAxML_placement_tree_healthy.tre
```
